applicabilityBasis.summary: Tempo documents pathUSD as a Bridge-issued, one-dollar-backed token used as a quote/routing asset in stablecoin payment settlement and as a fallback fee token. Bridge Building Inc. stablecoin terms provide eligible holders a fixed one-dollar fiat redemption obligation. Routing infrastructure rather than consumer-facing promotion does not itself exclude a token designed for settlement from the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN MSB registration and applicable state money-transmitter regulators for Bridge Building Inc. The OCC preliminary conditional approval applies to proposed Bridge National Trust Bank, not the current pathUSD issuer.
genius.notes: Current issuer is Bridge Building Inc., not proposed Bridge National Trust Bank. OCC Corporate Decision 1365 conditionally approves organization of that separate bank and withholds final opening approval until conditions are met; it is not a GENIUS PPSI grant. September 2026 Bridge disclosure still describes the bank as non-operational. Bridge publicly markets Open Issuance as GENIUS-ready; issuer-announced-intent here denotes that issuer-level positioning, not a token-specific application or approval. No established GENIUS pathway or primary federal payment-stablecoin regulator for the current issuer was found, so both are unknown. pathUSD's routing/settlement and fee uses, together with BBI's fixed-fiat redemption terms, support apparent-payment-stablecoin. Public reserve API is self-reported; quarterly-described attestations/monthly reports do not establish monthly independent attestations or statutory compliance. No evidence located in the checked sources establishes an earlier section 20 effective date or a current section 3(b) DASP prohibition on pathUSD.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific PPSI/state-qualified grant or official GENIUS application for pathUSD or its current issuer Bridge Building Inc. was located in these checked materials. The opened OCC record approves organization of a separate proposed bank conditionally under existing charter authority, not BBI or pathUSD under GENIUS. No public GENIUS enforcement action naming the current issuer/token was located in the scoped searches. This is a dated, bounded public-evidence review, not an assertion that no application has been filed, no nonpublic matter exists, or no issuer anywhere has approval.
